calls.title: Rom and August Allard
calls.summary: The discussion focused on the senior support engineer role, emphasizing the need for autonomy, technical troubleshooting skills, and strong client communication, particularly for enterprise customers. Rom Sagayadoro was highlighted as a strong candidate, bringing seven years of experience from Visa, where he managed complex financial service support and incident management using ServiceNow, along with skills in scripting and AI integration. The onboarding process for new hires is expected to take 2 to 6 months due to the complexity of GrowthBook's products, which center around A/B testing and feature flagging. The current support team is small, covering US East and EMEA time zones, with a crucial need for coverage in the Asia Pacific region. The interview process includes assessments of communication skills and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on cultural fit within the team.
calls.keywords: Support Engineering, Incident Management, Automation Scripting, AI Integration, A/B Testing, Growth Book
calls.action_items:
**August Allard**
Review the recorded interview call with Rom Sagayadoro (13:41)

Coordinate subsequent group interview involving support engineer and other Growth Book team members simulating complex customer requests (14:22)
Arrange a final interview call with co-founders Graham and/or Jeremy if Rom advances (14:22)
Provide Rom with updates on his application progress following internal review (15:15)

**Rom Sagayadoro**
Join Growth Book Slack and begin reviewing existing customer issues to accelerate onboarding if selected (13:34)
